1479-2841-8103-8293.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
1479-2841-8103-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

751-1753-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4881-6106-6909.manaNeeded: {2}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6106-6909.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-2146-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2146-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

618-2034-3305.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5686-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5686-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2366-2757-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
2366-2757-5702-7824.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
2366-2757-5702-7824.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

1368-1849-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1849-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2450-2510-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2450-2510-4050-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Semblance Anvil.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3384-4067-7602.description:
Activate Jacob by tapping it, causing you to draw two cards due to Thought Reflection and exile a card from your hand face-down. Choose not to pay to transform Jacob.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Jacob.
Repeat.

757-1432-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on it and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

104-3000-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-3000-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5921-5970-7060.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1029-3784-5028.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Vhal.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-3784-5028.notes: You can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

888-4067-6921.easyPrerequisites:
Biorganic Carapace is attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce {U} and a permanent that can tap to produce {R}.
888-4067-6921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two modified creatures.
888-4067-6921.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Biorganic Carapace attached, triggering it.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying the creature's trigger.
Resolve the copy of the creature's ability, drawing a card for each modified creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U/R}.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
888-4067-6921.notes: Depending on how many modified creatures you control, you may draw more cards than is needed to continue the loop. You can choose to keep those cards or discard them for additional results.

215-4231-5444-6753.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

643-950-1486-1753.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.
643-950-1486-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

2034-2525-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Double, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1909-4486-5840.notablePrerequisites: Nantuko Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1909-4486-5840.description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Nantuko Elder.
Repeat.

1462-1758-2351.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
1462-1758-2351.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Eidolon of Blossoms triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-4474-5467.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Wylie Duke.
4222-4474-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4474-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

372-2705-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Suspension Field returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Suspension Field until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

565-974-2450.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
565-974-2450.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting the Smaug token.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put the new Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Whim of Volrath from step 2, returning it to your hand.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other permanent(s) you control using Whim of Volrath, to create infinite tokens of them using Orvar.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House

1432-1434-3388.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House.
1432-1434-3388.description:
Activate Moritte's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature you control.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Moritte and another legendary creature you control.
Repeat.

2237-3259.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{R}, plus enough mana to cast the creature card in hand, if applicable
2237-3259.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand, or control another creature that entered the battlefield this turn.
You control any number of creatures that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
2237-3259.description:
If needed, cast any creature card by paying its mana cost.
Cast Breath of Fury by paying {2}{R}{R}, attaching it to a creature you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Goro-Goro and Satoru by paying {1}{R}, giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Goro-Goro and Satoru trigger.
Resolve the Goro-Goro and Satoru trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dragon Spirit token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1362-1479-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You have not played a land this turn.
You control at least six differently named lands.
1362-1479-3534.description:
If Oboro is on the battlefield, tap it for {U}.
Activate Oboro for {U}, returning it to your hand.
Play Oboro.
Field of the Dead and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, not putting anything onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
In response to the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, tap Oboro for {U}.
Activate Oboro, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro onto the battlefield from your hand.
Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

2724-3987-4243.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Venser, the Sojourner. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
